summary.oneLiner: A high-reliability, mission-critical electronics systems design and manufacturing (ESDM) company serving India's strategic defence and aerospace programmes.
summary.business: Merritronix is a B2B ESDM company specializing in high-reliability, mission-critical electronic assemblies and systems for defence, aerospace, telecommunications and specialized industrial electronics. Its integrated offering spans component sourcing, PCB (SMT/THT) assembly, system integration, testing and box-build/finished-product delivery, executed to defence and aerospace quality standards. Revenue is derived from turnkey manufacturing/build-to-print, obsolescence engineering management, trading sales and job work.

currentContext.business: Merritronix is a B2B ESDM company specializing in high-reliability, mission-critical electronic assemblies and systems for defence, aerospace, telecommunications and specialized industrial electronics. Its integrated offering spans component sourcing, PCB (SMT/THT) assembly, system integration, testing and box-build/finished-product delivery, executed to defence and aerospace quality standards. Revenue is derived from turnkey manufacturing/build-to-print, obsolescence engineering management, trading sales and job work.
currentContext.expansion: The Company intends to deploy IPO net proceeds towards capital expenditure on machinery and equipment (up to Rs. 2,136.43 lakhs, planned for FY2026-27) to expand its Hyderabad manufacturing capacity. Its installed capacity as on March 31, 2026 was 10,75,000 boards p.a. for SMT, 6,00,000 boards p.a. for THT and 4,20,000 units p.a. for box build, aggregating 17,85,000 production units per annum. Growth is being driven by increased order volumes from defence and aerospace customers, capacity expansion and a progressive shift toward higher-value turnkey manufacturing.
